problems.reason: One sentence classifies Proceratosaurus as a ceratosaurian, another as a tyrannosauroid (coelurosaurian tyrannosauroid).
Both sentences state that the crest was likely used for display.
Both sentences claim the animal fed on small prey based on bite force and skull morphology.
All three sentences describe the original classification as a species of Megalosaurus.
